AboutPage.title: About me
AboutPage.metaDescription: Full-stack engineer with 5+ years building distributed systems, AI tools, and scalable products. Based in Germany.
AboutPage.bio1: I'm a full-stack engineer based in Berlin, Germany, currently working at Infineon Technologies while finishing my Master's in Web Engineering at Chemnitz University of Technology.
AboutPage.bio2: I started writing code in 2019 and went from building 13 startups at a consultancy to backend engineering at enterprise scale — searching 200M products in under 5 seconds at OZON Tech, then building systems that save €480K/year at Infineon.
AboutPage.bio3: My current focus is on the intersection of distributed systems and AI — building things that are fast, reliable, and actually solve business problems. I write occasionally on Habr / Dev / Medium — the last article got 5K+ views.
AboutPage.bio4: Outside of engineering: chess, cycling, hiking, Lindy Hop dance, and Historical European martial arts. I've mentored 4 developers and translated the React Redux docs into Russian.
